title: Enterprise Technology Integration, B.S. (College of Information Sciences and Technology)
notes: University Park. Built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2022-2023/undergraduate/colleges/information-sciences-technology/enterprise-technology-integration-bs/, fetched and cross-checked against its own printed per-semester credit subtotals: 16/15/15/17/15/15+1(summer)/16.5/13.5 = 124 total, matching the page's own stated 'minimum of 124 credits'). Confirmed byte-identical in content to the 2023-24 archive (only the University Requirements boilerplate wording differs -- 'United States Cultures' vs 'Cultural Diversity Requirements' -- not the curriculum). This is the pre-2024 Semester-1 course order (CAS 100 in Fall, ENGL 15/30H in Spring -- swapped starting 2024-25) and predates the 2025-26 partial redesign (ETI 301/302/420/421 as ETI-or-IST OR-pairs, a three-way HCDD 331/IST 331/HCDD 264 item) and the 2026-27 full AI-focused overhaul (ETI 200, ETI 100 entrance option, ETI 400) documented in ETI-2026.json's own notes -- none of that exists on this year's page. Entrance-to-major is a real 5-way OR per this year's own prose ('HCDD 113S (FYS) or HCDD 113 or IST 110 or CYBER 100 or CYBER 100S (FYS)'), modeled as the item's full options list rather than just the SAP table's 2-way 'IST 110 or CYBER 100' shorthand, same convention ETI-2026.json's handbook pass used for its own entrance item. Real catalog-mismatch fixes applied (checked against the CURRENT course catalog scrape, which is not year-versioned so applies identically to every catalog year in this engine): (1) MATH 21 added as an explicit item -- ACCTG 211 and STAT 200 both real-require it and it appears nowhere else in this plan; MATH 21 itself has empty prereq_groups (its real prereq is a placement gate, not a course), so it needs no further chain, matching the same fact already verified for ETI-2026.json and DATSC. (2) This year's SAP prints 'IST 301', 'IST 302', 'IST 420', and 'IST 421' as single, non-OR items (no 'or ETI ###' alternative the way 2025-26 and 2026-27 both print) -- none of IST 301/302/420/421 exist in the catalog at all, so each was substituted for its real ETI-prefixed equivalent (ETI 301/302/420/421), the same substitution ETI-2026.json's own notes already document doing for this exact set of courses. (3) The real 'IST 331 or HCDD 264' item: IST 331 does not exist in the catalog; HCDD 264 does, but its real prereq (ETI 100, HCDD 113, or HCDD 113S) is not otherwise scheduled anywhere in this year's plan (ETI 100 did not exist as an entrance option until 2026-27). Added HCDD 113S as an explicit Semester 2 item to unlock it cleanly -- the same real gap and the same fix ETI-2026.json's own notes describe applying (and later removing once the 2026-27 redesign replaced this whole item with 'ETI 400 or 423', which was never true of this year's own printed requirements, so the fix stays here). (4) The real 'IST 423 or 402' item: IST 423 does not exist in the catalog (IST 402 does); substituted the non-existent alternative for its real ETI-prefixed equivalent, ETI 423, keeping IST 402 as printed -- options are ['ETI 423', 'IST 402']. Business Fundamentals Certificate Course and Application Focus Selection slots reuse ETI-2026.json's own match regexes unchanged as an approximation: this year's own printed Application Focus track lists (visually confirmed to have fewer named courses per track, e.g. the 2022 'Business Competency' track lists only BA 301/303/304/BLAW 243/IB 303 vs. 2026's larger combined pool) were not individually re-encoded since, per this app's existing CMPSC convention, these remain unfilled recommendation placeholders rather than enforced picks -- flagged here as an approximation, not a verified-identical claim, unlike the Prescribed/Additional course sequence above which is fully verified against this year's own archived page.
